# A. Cartola

> Ana Carolina Cartola (A. Cartola) is an Analytics Strategist with Engineering
> Depth. This site is her portfolio in data, analytics and engineering: business
> problems turned into measurement frameworks, data architecture, and clear
> narrative. Content is written in Portuguese (native) and English, with partial
> French and Chinese versions.

## Pages
- [Home](https://anacartola.com/): positioning and highlights.
- [Projects](https://anacartola.com/projects): data, analytics and engineering case studies.
- [Blog](https://anacartola.com/blog): technical writing on measurement, SQL and analytics engineering.
- [Resources](https://anacartola.com/resources): free tools, templates and calculators.
- [About](https://anacartola.com/about): bio, positioning and segments served.
- [Contact](https://anacartola.com/contact): LinkedIn, GitHub and email.

## Projects
- [Behavioural churn measurement](https://anacartola.com/projects/spades-churn-measurement): from a retention problem to a measurement framework, pipeline and narrative.
- [Recurring revenue model](https://anacartola.com/projects/diamonds-revenue-model): a cohort-based, auditable revenue model over raw billing.
- [Near-real-time event pipeline](https://anacartola.com/projects/clubs-data-pipeline): event ingestion with Kafka and orchestration in Airflow.

## Writing
- [A measurement framework before touching the pipeline](https://anacartola.com/blog/measurement-framework-churn): why the definition comes before the engineering.
- [Window functions every analyst should master](https://anacartola.com/blog/sql-window-functions): a practical tour of SQL window functions.

## Resources
- [Sample size calculator](https://anacartola.com/resources/sample-size-calculator): how many users per variant to detect an effect with confidence.
- [PRD template for data projects](https://anacartola.com/resources/prd-template-dados): a PRD skeleton for analytics and automation work.
- [Event instrumentation checklist](https://anacartola.com/resources/event-instrumentation-checklist): naming, properties, governance and validation before shipping an event.
